name: lofi
description: Lofi backgrounds with music for Claude Code: a pixel scene above the prompt with a generated loop under it, on while a turn runs or all the time. Eight scenes (night, snow, aquarium, campfire, fire, plasma, cube, matrix), four loops, /lofi to run it. Needs function hooks (early access).

music.title: Music
music.description: Play a generated lofi loop while the show is on

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: Which scene plays; auto cycles them

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: No flashes on tool calls (the calm scenes stay calm either way)

spinner.title: Spinner dancer
spinner.description: A tiny dancer beside the spinner line while a turn runs

always.title: Always on
always.description: Keep the show running between turns too, not only while Claude works

track.title: Track
track.description: Which loop plays; auto picks one for the scene
